demo.title: agenthub.sh
demo.code:
# Quote and open a 5x ETH long with a 5% stop (you confirm before it executes)
bankr prompt "Using the agenthub skill, long \$20 ETH 5x with a 5% stop"

# Positions, balance and limits
bankr prompt "Using the agenthub skill, show my positions and limits"

# Risk off
bankr prompt "Using the agenthub skill, close everything and pause trading"

setup: Needs a Bankr wallet API key with walletApiEnabled (sign messages and EIP-712 typed data, submit transactions on Base)
The trading wallet must be a plain EOA: Veranta rejects smart-wallet signatures
One-time: a gasless delegation signature and USDC approvals on Base, both guided by the skill
Execution costs $0.01 USDC per executed trade via x402 on Base; quotes, reads and setup are free
